methods: Compare original raster beside seven actual font renderings; do not claim identification from style alone.
Adjust lower-case width and x-height in an unslanted coordinate system, then restore the same pen slant; keep explicit cap metrics and advances.
Display, Compact and Text are reconstruction cuts selected by measured text roles; they do not establish that three fonts were used in the historical card.
Hand-design observed C, V, 0, 1, 3, 6, 7, 8 and hyphen as explicit cubic curves, convert to TrueType quadratics with 1-font-unit tolerance; no raster tracing.
Use a modest FreeType outline offset for printed stroke weight; this is an approximate reconstruction choice, not an original master.
Raw comparison retains natural advances and requested cap heights. Application fitting scales whole lines uniformly; no independent horizontal stretching.

Diagnostic overlays fit both base and study uniformly to the source line width, then optimize translation only within +/-15 horizontal and +/-30 vertical pixels. Source scan perspective/blur are retained.

interpretation.widths: Before application fitting, all seven raw line widths are within 4.74 percent of their native source crop widths. Layout fit is not proof of contour accuracy.
interpretation.name: Name ink IoU is essentially unchanged/slightly lower (0.2557 base vs 0.2526 study); 2 px foreground F1 is lower (0.5965 vs 0.5710). The study improves cap/x-height relation and uses a source-informed C, but the full name is not a verified contour match.
interpretation.telephone: Telephone ink IoU improves from 0.1775 to 0.2875; 2 px foreground F1 improves from 0.5442 to 0.6615. These are diagnostic overlaps, not percentages of historical accuracy.
interpretation.remaining: Small lettering anatomy, individual spacing, thin-stroke details, source perspective, printed ink spread and scan blur remain unresolved. No full historical alphabet is recoverable from this card alone.

rebuild.defaultOutput: An automatically created temporary directory when --output-dir is omitted.
rebuild.scope: Rebuilds three TTF fonts, complete OFL copies and provenance.json files. All hand-drawn curves, transformations, metrics and naming are included. Does not regenerate card SVG outlines, browser previews, comparison PNGs or diagnostic overlays; those are separate rendering stages.
rebuild.determinism: All three rebuilt TTF hashes were identical to the integrated candidate binaries in the tested environment. Modified timestamps are not recomputed. Bit-for-bit identity on a different FreeType version is not promised.

licensing: Pinyon OFL 1.1 is preserved. Original font copyright 2022 and distributed OFL copyright 2024 are both retained; their year difference is upstream metadata, not silently normalized.
